```{r}
# Loading way more libraries than needed
library(haven)
library(tidyr)
library(forcats)
library(tidyverse)
library(graphics)

# Read in all potential confounder data
InHomeW1 <- data.frame(read_xpt("M:/AddHealth/Data/Standard/Survey/W1/allwave1.xpt"))
BirthRecords <- data.frame(read_xpt("M:/AddHealth/Data/Standard/BirthRecords/brdw5.xpt"))
NHoodW1 <- data.frame(read_xpt("M:/AddHealth/Data/Standard/Grouping/nhood1.xpt"))
InSchoolW1 <- data.frame(read_xpt("M:/AddHealth/Data/Standard/InSchool/Inschool.xpt"))
ContextW1 <- data.frame(read_xpt("M:/AddHealth/Data/Standard/Contextual/W1/Context1.xpt"))
HealthW1 <- data.frame(read_xpt("M:/AddHealth/Data/Standard/Contextual/W1/Health1.xpt"))
SpatialW1 <- data.frame(read_xpt("M:/AddHealth/Data/Standard/Contextual/W1/Spatial.xpt"))
Stchr95W1 <- data.frame(read_xpt("M:/AddHealth/Data/Standard/Contextual/W1/stchr95.xpt"))
PolConW1 <- data.frame(read_xpt("M:/AddHealth/Data/Standard/Contextual/W1/w1polcon.xpt"))
weights <- data.frame(read_xpt("M:/AddHealth/Data/Standard/Weights/Homewt1.xpt"))
weights$PSUSCID <- as.integer(weights$PSUSCID)

# Join all confounder dataframes by person ID (AID)
message("Merging data files by AID...")
dfs <- list(InHomeW1, BirthRecords, NHoodW1, InSchoolW1, ContextW1, HealthW1, SpatialW1, Stchr95W1, PolConW1, weights)
target_col <- "AID"
dfs <- lapply(dfs, function(d) {
  d[[target_col]] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(d[[target_col]])))
  d
})
w1All <- purrr::reduce(dfs, ~ dplyr::left_join(.x, .y, by = "AID"))

# Add school admin data separately, which needs to be joined based on cluster
schooladmn <- data.frame(read_xpt("M:/AddHealth/Data/Standard/InSchool/Schadm1.xpt"))
names(schooladmn)[names(schooladmn) == "ASCHLCDE"] <- "PSUSCID"
schooladmn$PSUSCID <- as.integer(schooladmn$PSUSCID)
w1All$PSUSCID <- as.integer(w1All$PSUSCID)
dfs <- list(w1All, schooladmn)
target_col <- "PSUSCID"
dfs <- lapply(dfs, function(d) {
  d[[target_col]] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(d[[target_col]])))
  d
})
w1All <- purrr::reduce(dfs, ~ dplyr::left_join(.x, .y, by = "PSUSCID"))

# Read in exposure data - CES-D questionnaire for mental health in the second round
InHomeW2 <- data.frame(read_xpt("M:/AddHealth/Data/Standard/Survey/W2/wave2.xpt"))
MHcols <- c("H2FS1","H2FS2","H2FS3","H2FS4","H2FS5","H2FS6","H2FS7","H2FS8","H2FS9","H2FS10",
            "H2FS11","H2FS12","H2FS13","H2FS14","H2FS15","H2FS16","H2FS17","H2FS18","H2FS19")
InHomeW2$AID <- as.numeric(as.character(InHomeW2$AID))
w1AllMH <- w1All %>%
  left_join(InHomeW2 %>% select(AID, all_of(MHcols)), by = "AID")

# Filter to complete exposure data (I'm framing my research question to exclude people who did not complete this questionnaire in the second round)
Nonresponse <- c(6, 8, 9)
MainSample <- w1AllMH %>%
  filter(if_all(all_of(MHcols), ~ !(.x %in% Nonresponse) & !is.na(.x)))

# Making NA its own level in factors
df = MainSample
df[] = lapply(df, function(x) {
  if (is.factor(x)) {
    x = addNA(x)
    levels(x) [is.na(levels(x))] = "NA"
  }
  x
})

# Adding missingness indicators and imputing for numeric variables using means
codes = c(96, 97, 98, 99)
for (nm in names(df) [sapply(df, is.numeric)]) {
  x = df[[nm]]
  top4 = head(sort(x[!is.na(x)], decreasing = TRUE), 4)
  if (!length(top4) || !any(top4 %% 100 %in% codes)) next
  suf = x %% 100
  missA = is.na(x) | suf %in% c(96, 98, 99)
  miss97 = !is.na(x) & suf == 97
  m = mean(x[!(missA | miss97)], na.rm = TRUE)
  df[[paste0(nm, "_missA")]] = as.integer(missA)
  df[[paste0(nm, "_miss97")]] = as.integer(miss97)
  x[missA | miss97] = m
  df[[nm]] = x
}
MainSample = df

#Standardizing the data type for next step in processing
to_num <- function(x) {                                                 # coerce numeric-ish vectors robustly
  x_chr <- as.character(x)                                              # convert to character
  x_chr <- gsub("[, ]", "", x_chr)                                      # strip commas/spaces
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x_chr))                                   # coerce to numeric
}                                                                       # end to_num
w1AllMHtypes <- as.data.frame(lapply(MainSample, to_num), check.names = FALSE)

# Lazy way to make factors - anything with 10 unique values, not including the missingness values, is a factor
bad_codes <- c(96, 97, 98, 99)
should_be_factor <- vapply(w1AllMHtypes, function(col) {
  num <- to_num(col)
  uniq <- unique(num[!is.na(num) & !(num %in% bad_codes)])
  length(uniq) <= 10
}, logical(1))
factor_cols <- names(w1AllMHtypes)[should_be_factor]
w1AllMHtypes[factor_cols] <- lapply(w1AllMHtypes[factor_cols], as.factor)

# Processing some factors that have more than 10 unique values
long_factors <- c("H1HR3A","H1HR5A","H1HR13","H1GI12","H1NM4","H1NF4","H1RM1","H1RM3","H1RM4",
                  "H1RF1","H1RF3","H1RF4","H1RI5A_1","H1RI5A_2","H1RI5A_3","H1RI15_1","H1RI29A1",
                  "H1RI29B1","H1RI29C1","H1RI15_2","H1RI15_3","H1RX5A_1","H1RX15_1","H1RX5A_2",
                  "H1RX15_2","H1RX5A_3","H1RX15_3","H1RE1","PA12","PA22","PB7","PB8","COMMID.x",
                  "COMMID.y","H1TO37","H1TO34","H1TO30","H1TO2","H1TO40","H1FV14M","H1FV14Y")
for (v in long_factors) {
  if (v %in% names(w1AllMHtypes)) w1AllMHtypes[[v]] <- as.factor(w1AllMHtypes[[v]])
}
hr6_cols <- grep("H1HR6", names(w1AllMHtypes), value = TRUE)
if (length(hr6_cols) > 0) w1AllMHtypes[hr6_cols] <- lapply(w1AllMHtypes[hr6_cols], as.factor)

# Calculating round 2 CES-D scores
MHSumCols <- names(w1AllMHtypes)[grep("H2FS", names(w1AllMHtypes))]
for (col in MHSumCols) w1AllMHtypes[[col]] <- as.numeric(as.character(w1AllMHtypes[[col]]))
HappyCols <- c("H2FS4", "H2FS8", "H2FS11", "H2FS15")
for (col in HappyCols) if (col %in% names(w1AllMHtypes)) w1AllMHtypes[[col]] <- 3 - w1AllMHtypes[[col]]
w1AllMHtypes$MHSum <- rowSums(w1AllMHtypes[, MHSumCols], na.rm = FALSE)

# Applying cut-point for CES-D based on "Epidemiology of Depressive Symptons in the National Survey of Adolescent Health." Elsewhere I made sure that this cut point was equivalent to the one in the paper, accounting for complex survey design
Cutpoint <- 22
w1AllMHtypes$Depressed <- as.integer(w1AllMHtypes$MHSum >= Cutpoint)

# Removing duplicate columns
w1AllMHtypes = w1AllMHtypes[, !grepl("\\.y$",names(w1AllMHtypes)), drop=FALSE]

# Functions for binomial and gaussian linear regressions, in a way that ensures that factors are considered together and missingness indicators are considered together

seed = 1
screen_binom = function(y, X, K=5, seed = 1, eps = 1e-15) {
  stopifnot(all(y %in% 0:1))
  set.seed(seed); n = length(y); fold = sample(rep(1:K, length.out = n))
  
  clip = function(p) pmin(pmax(p, eps), 1- eps)
  logloss = function(y, p) -mean(y * log(p) + (1 - y) * log(1-p))
  
  p0 = numeric(n)
  for (k in 1:K) { tr = fold != k; te = !tr; p0[te] = mean(y[tr]) }
  ll0 = logloss(y, clip(p0))
  
  vapply(names(X), function(nm){
    col = X[[nm]]
    if (grepl("(_missA|_miss97)$", nm)) return(NA_real_)
    
    p = numeric(n)
    
    if (is.numeric(col)) {
      miss_names = paste0(nm, c("_missA", "_miss97"))
      miss_names = miss_names[miss_names %in% names(X)]
      
      for (k in 1:K) {
        tr = fold != k; te = !tr
        xt = col[tr]; yt = y[tr]
        mu = mean(xt, na.rm = TRUE)
        if (is.finite(mu)) { p[te] = mean(yt); next}
        
        xtr = xt - mu
        xtr[is.na(xtr)] = 0
        
        Xtr = cbind(1)
        if (!all(xtr = 0)) Xtr = cbind(Xtr, xtr)
        
        if (length(miss_names) > 0) {
          Mtr = data.matrix(X[tr, miss_names, drop=FALSE])
          Mtr[is.na(Mtr)] = 0
          storage.mode(Mtr) = "numeric"
          Xtr = cbind(Xtr, Mtr)
        } else {
          mtr = is.na(xt)
          Xtr = cbind(Xtr, mtr)
        }
        
        
        b = glm.fit(Xtr, yt, family = binomial())$coefficients
        
        xte = col[te] - mu
        xte[is.na(xte)] = 0
        Xte = cbind(1)
        if (!all(xtr == 0)) Xte = cbind(Xte, xte)
        
        if (length(miss_names) > 0) {
          Mte = as.matrix(X[te, miss_names, drop=FALSE])
          Mte[is.na(Mte)] = 0
          storage.mode(Mtr) = "numeric"
          Xte = cbind(Xte, Mte)
        } else {
          mte = is.na(col[te])
          Xte = cbind(Xte, mte)
        }
        
        p[te] = plogis(Xte %*% b)
      }
    } else {
      f = addNA(as.factor(col))
      for (k in 1:K) {
        tr = fold != k; te = !tr
        yt = y[tr]; ft = f[tr]
        s = tapply(yt, ft, sum); nn = tapply(yt, ft, length)
        levp = (s + 0.5) / (nn + 1)
        pbar = (sum(yt) + 0.5) / (length(yt) + 1)
        pk = levp[as.character(f[te])]
        p[te] = ifelse(is.na(pk), pbar, pk)
      }
    }
    
    ll = logloss(y, clip(p))
    1 - ll / ll0
  }, numeric(1))
}

screen_gauss = function(y, X, K=5, seed = 1) {
  set.seed(seed); n = length(y); fold = sample(rep(1:K, length.out = n))
  
  loss = function(y, yhat) mean(abs(y - yhat))
  
  y0 = numeric(n)
  for (k in 1:K) { tr = fold !=k; te = !tr;y0[te] = median(y[tr]) }
  loss0 = loss(y, y0)
  
  vapply(names(X), function(nm){
    col = X[[nm]]
    if (is.matrix(col)) {
      if (ncol(col) == 1L) col = col[,1]
      else return(NA_real_)
    }
    if (grepl("(_missA|_miss97)$", nm)) return(NA_real_)
    
    
    yhat = numeric(n)
    
    if (is.numeric(col)) {
      miss_names = paste0(nm, c("_missA", "_miss97"))
      miss_names = miss_names[miss_names %in% names(X)]
      
      for (k in 1:K) {
        tr = fold != k; te = !tr
        xt = col[tr]; yt = y[tr]
        mu = mean(xt, na.rm = TRUE)
        if (!is.finite(mu)) { yhat[te] = mean(yt); next}
        
        xtr = xt - mu
        xtr[is.na(xtr)] = 0
        
        Xtr = matrix(1, nrow = sum(tr), ncol = 1)
        if (!all(xtr == 0)) Xtr = cbind(Xtr, xtr)
        
        if (length(miss_names) > 0) {
          Mtr = as.matrix(X[tr, miss_names, drop=FALSE])
          Mtr[is.na(Mtr)] = 0
          Xtr = cbind(Xtr, Mtr)
        } else {
          mtr = is.na(xt)
          Xtr = cbind(Xtr, mtr)
        }
        
        b = lm.fit(Xtr, yt)$coefficients
        b[is.na(b)] = 0
        
        xte = col[te] - mu
        xte[is.na(xte)] = 0
        Xte = matrix(1, nrow = sum(te), ncol = 1)
        if (!all(xtr == 0)) Xte = cbind(Xte, xte)
        
        if (length(miss_names) > 0) {
          Mte = data.matrix(X[te, miss_names, drop=FALSE])
          Mte[is.na(Mte)] = 0
          Xte = cbind(Xte, Mte)
        } else {
          mte = is.na(col[te])
          Xte = cbind(Xte, mte)
        }
        
        yhat[te] = drop(Xte %*% b)
      }
    } else {
      f = addNA(as.factor(col))
      for (k in 1:K) {
        tr = fold != k; te = !tr
        yt = y[tr]; ft = f[tr]
        levm = tapply(yt, ft, mean)
        ybar = mean(yt)
        mk = levm[as.character(f[te])]
        yhat[te] = ifelse(is.na(mk), ybar, mk)
      }
    }
    
    cor(y,yhat,method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")^2
  }, numeric(1))
}

# Preparing variables
safe_remove_cols <- function(df, pattern) {
idx <- grep(pattern, names(df))
if (length(idx) > 0) {
df <- df[, -idx, drop = FALSE]
}
df
}
df_x <- w1AllMHtypes
df_x <- safe_remove_cols(df_x, "MHSum")
df_x <- safe_remove_cols(df_x, "Depressed")
df_x <- safe_remove_cols(df_x, "PSUSCID")
df_x <- safe_remove_cols(df_x, "H2FS")

# Running regression for exposure
y <- w1AllMHtypes$Depressed
exposurescores = screen_binom(y, df_x)
```

```{r}


# Read in outcome data - personal earnings. I'm dropping missing values in the outcome for this pre-pre-screening, but will use a missingness indicator instead in my next steps

InHomeW4 <- data.frame(read_xpt("M:/AddHealth/Data/Standard/Survey/W4/wave4.xpt"))
Earnings = c("H4EC2","H4EC3")
InHomeW4$AID <- as.numeric(as.character(InHomeW4$AID))
MainSample <- df_x %>%
  left_join(InHomeW4 %>% select(AID, all_of(Earnings)), by = "AID")
MainSample <- MainSample %>%
  filter(if_all(all_of("H4EC2"), ~ !is.na(.x)))
Nonresponse <- c(96, 98)
w1AllMHtypes <- MainSample %>%
  filter(if_all(all_of("H4EC3"), ~ !(.x %in% Nonresponse) & !is.na(.x)))


#Estimating the personal earnings

w1AllMHtypes = mutate(w1AllMHtypes, Earnings = ifelse(H4EC2<9999996, H4EC2, ifelse(H4EC3 == 1, 2500, ifelse(H4EC3 == 2, 7500, ifelse(H4EC3 == 3, 12500, ifelse(H4EC3 == 4, 17500, ifelse(H4EC3 == 5, 22500, ifelse(H4EC3 == 6, 27500, ifelse(H4EC3 == 7, 35000, ifelse(H4EC3 == 8, 45000, ifelse(H4EC3 == 9, 62500,  ifelse(H4EC3 == 10, 87500, ifelse(H4EC3 == 11, 125000, 175000)))))))))))))
w1AllMHtypes$Earnings = as.numeric(w1AllMHtypes$Earnings)

# Dropping the outliers. Not great, but these values look made up - an unrealistic amount of people making $800k+.

df = w1AllMHtypes %>% filter(Earnings <= 600000) 

df_x <- safe_remove_cols(df, "Earnings")
df_x <- safe_remove_cols(df_x, "H4EC2")
df_x <- safe_remove_cols(df_x, "H4EC3")

# Now running regression for outcomes
y <- df$Earnings
outcomescores = screen_gauss(y, df_x)
summary(y)
```

```{r}

# Making elbow plots for exposure regressions

s1 = sort(exposurescores, decreasing = TRUE)

x = seq_along(s1)
xn = (x - x[1])/(x[length(x)] - x[1])
yn = (s1 - s1[length(s1)])/(s1[1] - s1[length(s1)])
d = abs(yn - (1 - xn))/sqrt(2)

knee_rank = which.max(d)
knee_value1 = s1[knee_rank]


plot(s1, type = "l", xlab = "Rank best -> worst", ylab = "Score")
#abline(v = knee_rank, lty = 2)
#abline(h = knee_value, lty = 2)

text(knee_rank, knee_value1 + .02,
     labels = sprintf("Cutoff = %.4f (rank %d)", knee_value1, knee_rank),
     pos = 4, xpd = NA)

#Can't see it, but cutpoint was rank 316

```

```{r}
# Making elbow plots for outcomes regressions

s2 = sort(outcomescores, decreasing = TRUE, na.last = NA)

x = seq_along(s2)
xn = (x - x[1])/(x[length(x)] - x[1])
yn = (s2 - s2[length(s2)])/(s2[1] - s2[length(s2)])
d = abs(yn - (1 - xn))/sqrt(2)

knee_rank2 = which.max(d)
knee_value2 = s2[knee_rank2]

plot(s2, type = "l", xlab = "Rank best -> worst", ylab = "Score")
```

```{r}
keepexposure = (s1)[s1 >= knee_value1]
keepoutcome = (s2)[s2 >= knee_value2]

keepboth = c(keepexposure, keepoutcome)
keepboth = keepboth[!duplicated(names(keepboth))]
```
